headline: Is Brown Forman (BF.B) Undervalued As It Searches For A New CEO?
summary: Brown-Forman (BF.B) has drawn fresh investor attention after announcing that long-serving CEO and President Lawson Whiting plans to retire. The board has launched a formal search for his successor and is emphasizing business continuity. See our latest analysis for Brown-Forman. At a share price of $26.08, Brown-Forman has seen a 1-day share price return of 1.48% and a 7-day share price return of 1.95%, but the 1-year total shareholder return is down 12.89%. headline: The Bull Case For Brown-Forman (BF.B) Could Change Following CEO Exit And Dividend Reaffirmation – Learn Why
summary: Brown-Forman’s July 23, 2026 board meeting approved a regular quarterly cash dividend of US$0.2310 per share, extending an 82-year record of uninterrupted payouts and 42 years of dividend increases for both its Class A and Class B stock.
